# Integration Audit: Ollama

- Reviewed: 2026-07-23
- Used as architectural reference: yes
- Whole upstream tree copied: no
- Source ZIP retained: no
- Runtime dependency introduced: no
- Documentation set: one audit, one manifest, one readme, one license record

## Applied concepts

Reviewed its local-first model-service pattern and simple provider API boundary. Applied the local-first principle so browser procedural 3D creation remains available when the cloud endpoint or an external text-to-3D provider is unavailable. No Ollama binaries, models, or server code were copied.
